papers.title: Effect of Process-Controlled Energy Density on Defects and Microstructural Evolution in SLM-Processed Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effect of various energy density (VED) levels—determined by process parameters such as laser scan spacing (h), layer thickness (t), laser power (P), and scan speed (v)—on the hardness, porosity defects, and microstructure of Ti6Al4V alloy blocks fabricated using the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process. In this work, the scan spacing (h) and layer thickness (t) were kept constant, while various combinations of laser power (P) and scanning speed (v) were systematically evaluated. In the initial phase of the study, two power levels—200 W and 400 W—were applied under a constant VED of 262 J/mm³ to assess their influence on the process response. The results revealed that the samples produced at the lower power (200 W) exhibited significantly poorer surface quality. In the second stage, ten different parameter combinations were tested using a constant laser power of 400 W, with the corresponding VED values ranging from 97 to 427 J/mm³. The results indicated a substantial reduction in porosity and LOF defects as the VED increased up to 262 J/mm³, beyond which no significant improvement in part quality was observed. Microhardness measurements (Vickers) and microstructural analyses using optical microscopy confirmed that the variation in energy density within the studied range had only a minor influence on hardness. The micrographs also demonstrated that the build direction notably affected grain orientation, with elongated columnar grains aligned along the build direction. Overall, this study concludes that energy density alone cannot serve as the sole criterion for process optimization, as it is a combined outcome of several parameters and may produce parts of distinctly different quality even at identical VED values.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究SLM Ti-6Al-4V的硬度与缺陷，符合L1方向对力学性能的要求，但缺乏拉伸与疲劳数据。
llm.why_not_core: No tensile or fatigue data; only hardness and defect analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究工艺参数控制的能量密度对SLM Ti-6Al-4V缺陷与微观组织的影响
summary_zh.method: 恒定扫描间距与层厚，改变激光功率与扫描速度，获得不同体能量密度并分析其影响
summary_zh.result: 能量密度增至262 J/mm³后孔隙率显著降低，但对硬度影响较小；能量密度不独立决定质量
summary_zh.validation: 通过维氏硬度测试与金相显微镜验证缺陷与组织的差异

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to understand the role of volumetric energy density (VED) in controlling defects and microstructure during selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: By varying laser power and scan speed while keeping scan spacing and layer thickness constant, ten VED conditions (97–427 J/mm³) were produced and characterized.
summary_en.result: Porosity and lack-of-fusion defects decreased significantly up to VED=262 J/mm³, but further VED increase yielded no improvement; microhardness showed only minor variation across the range.
summary_en.validation: Vickers microhardness and optical microscopy were used to correlate process parameters with defect density and microstructural features.

papers.title: Effect of anodization voltage and heat treatment on the surface crystallinity and hydrophilicity of the Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: The formation of superhydrophilic surfaces on Ti-6Al-4V was achieved through anodization at different voltages, followed by heat treatment at 1000℃ for 2 h. This treatment not only enhanced surface crystallinity but also induced morphological changes. A comprehensive analysis of surface properties, including morphology, phase composition, elemental structure, surface roughness, and hydrophilicity, was conducted using OM, FE-SEM, EDX, XRD, AFM, 3D laser scanning confocal microscope, and contact angle measurements, respectively. The TiO2 anodized films exhibited enhanced crystallinity, increased surface roughness, and a higher oxygen-to-titanium ratio. As a result, the TiO2 anodized films showed consistent morphology and distribution of elements, with high temperature annealing leading to a transformation from amorphous to crystalline structures, accompanied by elevated surface roughness, and augmented hydrophilicity.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究阳极氧化和热处理对Ti-6Al-4V表面结晶性和亲水性的影响，未涉及疲劳或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical performance (fatigue, tensile) data; only surface crystallinity and hydrophilicity characterized.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究阳极氧化电压和热处理对Ti-6Al-4V表面性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在不同电压下阳极氧化并1000℃热处理，表征表面形貌、相组成和润湿性。
summary_zh.result: 热处理提高了TiO2膜的结晶度、粗糙度和亲水性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过OM、SEM、XRD、AFM和接触角测量进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of anodization voltage and subsequent heat treatment on the surface properties of Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V samples were anodized at various voltages and then heat-treated at 1000°C for 2 h, followed by comprehensive surface characterization using multiple techniques.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment transformed amorphous TiO2 to crystalline structure, increased surface roughness, and enhanced hydrophilicity.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through experimental surface characterization including OM, FE-SEM, EDX, XRD, AFM, 3D laser microscopy, and contact angle measurements.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Metallurgical & Materials Engineering, National Institute of Technology Srinagar, J&K, 190006, India

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-6Al-4V基体上的涂层，而非增材制造Ti-6Al-4V本身的力学或疲劳性能，与用户关注的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V力学性能方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address additive manufacturing of Ti-6Al-4V; it studies coatings on wrought Ti-6Al-4V and reports nanomechanical properties rather than bulk mechanical or fatigue performance relevant to AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发用于承重生物医学应用的梯度涂层
summary_zh.method: 利用磁控溅射沉积TaN/CrN/ZrN梯度薄膜
summary_zh.result: 涂层改善了表面润湿性和纳米力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、接触角测量和纳米压痕进行表征

summary_en.motivation: To develop functionally graded thin-film coatings for load-bearing biomedical Ti-6Al-4V implants
summary_en.method: TaN/CrN/ZrN coatings were deposited by magnetron sputtering
